answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 29775 Country: India Title: I have read somewhere that durud shareif should not be read after attahiyat while offering qaza namaz is it correct. Also if correct will my qaza namaz will be accepted or not? Question: I have read somewhere that durud shareif should not be read after attahiyat while offering qaza namaz is it correct. Also if correct will my qaza namaz will be accepted or not? Answer ID: 29775 Posted on: Aug 28, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 282/282/M=1432) What you have heard is wrong. The method of qaza and ada salah is same. Hence, one should recite durood after tashahhud while offering qaza salah also. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
